objective: Resolve an already-normalized Telnyx voice event through additive call-leg correlation into the canonical InsuranceContactAttempt and explicit operator/lead leg role without webhook transport, provider commands, bridge mutation, or D1 writes.
resolutionFlow: lookup correlation by provider plus event.callControlId
if correlation is absent return unmatched
if canonical attempt is absent return orphaned-correlation
verify correlation attempt identity matches the loaded canonical attempt
return event plus canonical attempt plus explicit legRole plus correlation
identityRules: operator and lead roles come only from persisted River correlation.
event.callControlId must match the persisted correlation providerReference.
call_session_id and call_leg_id do not determine operator versus lead role.
The canonical attempt providerReference is not required to equal every correlated call leg.
next: INS-002E2C3 can deterministically reconcile correlated operator/lead Telnyx lifecycle evidence into the operator-first bridge domain before any public webhook activation.
